limitations: Untuned public-UI prototype; no browser acceptance evidence.
Native completion is not proof admission or independent replay; caller owns those checks.
Releasing keys retains throttle; caller must close or safely pause its isolated browser on failure.

independentReplay.method: Independent off-browser replay of the actual native UI proof export
independentReplay.isolation: Fresh bounded Node child; exact admitted/current executable closure; JSON-only locales; env {}

limitations: Automated native flight-01 exercise through visible maintained Detailed HUD and W/S/Shift keys; DOM course/mode identity metadata is not a visible measurement. Final actual UI export and independent replay bind the course and mode.
Prototype feedback gains, not physical controller, human learning, rotational Acro proficiency, accessibility or campaign-win qualification.

Only native completion with no helper error, successful owned-key cleanup, completion screenshot, actual UI backup export and successful exact-package off-browser replay can pass a case. No injected commands, demonstrations or runtime hooks.
Starts from stable launchers and locally staged admitted bytes/current.json fixtures; no main-game directory, installation/offline or hosting acceptance.
Single EN Academy Self-level probe, not the complete eight-case FPV matrix.
